dish.title: Indo-Chinese Gobi Manchurian with Basmati Rice
dish.description: Cauliflower florets coated in a cornstarch-and-flour batter with chili powder, shallow-fried crisp, then tossed in a glossy sauce of ginger, garlic, onion, green bell pepper, soy sauce, ketchup, sriracha, and rice vinegar with scallions, served with basmati rice.

recipe_version.title: Indo-Chinese Gobi Manchurian with Basmati Rice
recipe_version.description: Cauliflower florets coated in a cornstarch-and-flour batter with chili powder, shallow-fried crisp, then tossed in a glossy sauce of ginger, garlic, onion, green bell pepper, soy sauce, ketchup, sriracha, and rice vinegar with scallions, served with basmati rice.

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: for shallow-frying, about 1/3 inch deep in the 12-inch skillet

ingredients.name: ketchup
ingredients.display_name: ketchup whose label lists tomato concentrate, vinegar, sugar, salt, and spices

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Cut the cauliflower into 1 1/2-inch florets. Mince the ginger and garlic, cut the onion and bell pepper into 1-inch squares, slice the scallions, and rinse the rice until the rinse runs clear.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: While you batter, shallow-fry, and sauce in steps 3-6 (overlap stated): combine the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, and 1/2 tsp salt in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high, about 4 minutes, then cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes. Leave it covered off the heat to rest 10 minutes.

steps.title: Batter
steps.body: Whisk the 1/2 cup cornstarch, the flour, chili powder, and 1 tsp salt with 1/2 cup water to a batter like thin pancake batter. Toss the florets in it until coated.

steps.title: Shallow-fry
steps.body: Heat the oil (about 1/3 inch deep) in the 12-inch heavy skillet over medium-high to 350 F, about 5 minutes. Shallow-fry half the florets, turning, until crisp and golden all over, about 6 minutes per batch. Lift onto the rack and repeat (2 batches).

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Carefully pour all but 2 tbsp oil into the heatproof bowl. Over high heat cook the ginger and garlic for 30 seconds, then the onion and bell pepper for 3 minutes. Add the soy sauce, ketchup, sriracha, vinegar, and 3/4 cup water and bring to a simmer, about 1 minute. Stir the 1 tbsp cornstarch into 2 tbsp water, stir it in, and simmer until glossy, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.body: Toss the cauliflower and most of the scallions in the sauce for 30 seconds. Serve over the fluffed rice with the remaining scallions.

equipment: wire rack set on a sheet pan
